Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Indore Project Administrative Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Indore Project Administrative Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Administrative Assistant post at IIT Indore is scheduled for 13 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University/Institute. Additionally, knowledge of computer operations is essential for this role.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any experience required for the Project Administrative Assistant position?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates are required to have a minimum of 02 years of relevant experience in a similar administrative role to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Administrative Assistant position is 35 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Administrative Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Administrative Assistant position will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 30,000.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the Project Administrative Assistant position at IIT Indore?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a Walk-in Interview. Interested and eligible candidates need to attend the interview at the specified venue on the given date with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Project Administrative Assistant position is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the IIT Indore campus located?
faq.answer: IIT Indore is located in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, with the pincode 453552. The specific venue for the walk-in interview will be detailed in the official notification.
